line: Prabhu, main Aries walon ki wakeel hun, aur poore 2026 ka hisaab laayi hun.
Itni moti file? Wakeel saahiba, ye shikayat hai ya kisi shaadi ka menu hai?
Poore saal kharcha zyada hua, neend nahi aayi, aur jo share kharida wo turant gir gaya.
Aries wale share bhi Mangal ki speed se kharidte hain. Khair, 2026 mein Shani dev baarahve, kharchon wale ghar mein hain, isliye paisa aur neend dono hile.
Arey baap re!
Ye toh gadbad hai re baba, kahin 2027 bhi aisa hi na jaye!
Tension lene ka nahi, wakeel saahiba. Isiliye toh mol-bhaav ho raha hai, bolo kya chahiye?
Abhi maza aayega na bhidu!
Pehli demand ye hai ki January se hi naya kaam shuru ho jaye.
Aries ke swami Mangal das January se ek April tak vakri rahenge, toh bade faisle April tak roko.
Lekin ek second!
Matlab mere client ko January, February, March, bas tareekh pe tareekh milti rahegi?
Tareekh nahi, taiyaari ka time milega, aur jo ruk gaya wahi jeetega.
Theek hai, toh ghar mein sukoon dila dijiye.
January ke aakhir se June tak Guru chauthe ghar mein hain, par Ketu bhi wahin hain, toh family ko waqt dena padega.
Aur maasi poochti hain shaadi kab hogi, aur shaadi ho gayi toh good news kab?
Hey Bhagwan, kya karun main!
Maasi ka jawab toh mere paas bhi nahi hai. Par 2026 mein Ketu ne pyaar aur bachchon ke ghar mein jo ulajhan di, June 2027 ke aakhir se wahan Guru aa rahe hain.
Aur last demand, Aries walon ko Shani dev se darr nahi lagta, Sade Sati se lagta hai, use cancel kar dijiye.
Wo Shani dev ka vibhag hai, wahan sifaarish nahi chalti. Sade Sati ka bhaari beech ka daur June 2027 mein pehli dastak dega, aur Shani dev mehnat ka phal dete hain, darr ka nahi.
Toh faisla aa gaya: kaam ko April ki tareekh, ghar ko aadha sukoon, rishte ko Guru ka saath, aur Sade Sati ke liye mehnat ka raasta. Wakeel haari nahi, Aries jeet gaye!
2027 ko manifest karna hai toh link pe click karo, aur ye video us dost ko bhejo jo isse relate karega.
